plugins.name: estimator
plugins.description: Estimate Jira tickets from your team's actual history. Pulls resolved tickets via the Atlassian MCP to build a baseline, then suggests effort/story-point estimates by comparing new work to similar past tickets.

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Save your open Claude Code terminal sessions and reopen them later (after a reboot, a terminal update, or the next day): each resumed in its original folder and terminal. Windows and Linux.
